key_insight: NABLA adapts the memory of structured matrix preconditioners to observed gradient dynamics, yielding a noise-adaptive convergence guarantee without prior knowledge of the noise level.
engineering_relevance: Block-diagonal row and column preconditioning offers a memory-efficient approach to mini-batch optimization with automatically adjusted second-moment averaging.
method: Combine fixed-coefficient gradient momentum with blockwise left-right matrix preconditioning.
Construct row and column preconditioners from matrix-valued second-moment statistics.
Adjust second-moment averaging through feedback from cumulative stochastic-gradient energy and its running average.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical stability and stationarity guarantees of Õ(T^(-1/2) + σ^(1/2)T^(-1/4)), but provides no empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: The guarantees require spectral-boundedness and other standard assumptions; practical matrix-update overhead is not evaluated in the abstract.
paper_title: NABLA: A Noise-Adaptive Blockwise Left-Right Preconditioning Algorithm for Stochastic Optimization
